name: Elemental Transfiguration: Burning Blessing
description:
Elemental Transfiguration: Pyro Dendro
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Pyro Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you trigger a Burning Reaction: Discard this card, then choose either Burning Blessing: Maximal Ferocity or Burning Blessing: Supreme Symphony and add it to your Hand.
